page.title: Super Admin panel
page.intro: Full management of users, clients and links. Privileged actions run server-side with the service role.

healthPage.title: Data health check
healthPage.intro: Data problems caught before professionals report them: broken bridges, orphan measurements, duplicate records and forgotten requests.

serviceRole.title: Service role not configured
serviceRole.body: The Super Admin panel needs the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on the server. Add it to .env.local (and to the Vercel env), then reload. You find it in Supabase → Project Settings → API → service_role.
serviceRole.healthBody: The report needs the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on the server.

hints.no_link: The client has no link to a professional, neither active nor pending.
hints.pending_link: A link is waiting for acceptance: the professional must accept it in the app, or you can activate it from the Links tab.
hints.revoked_link: The client only has revoked links: reactivate one from the Links tab or create a new one.
hints.incomplete_profile: The professional_profiles row is missing: the professional has not completed the profile.
hints.no_profile: The user exists in auth but has no profiles row: no role assigned.

clients.noAppAccountHint: No link to an account: client followed without the app, or account not linked yet
clients.linkHint: Link the client's app account (by email) to this professional
clients.mergeHint: Merge with another record of the same professional

newClient.title: New client
newClient.description: Create a client and assign it to a professional.
newClient.createAccess: Also create the client's app access (requires email)
newClient.errName: Enter at least a first or last name
newClient.okAccessError: Record created, but access not created: {error}
newClient.okWarning: Record created, but link not created: {warning}
newClient.okAccount: Client created with account and active link
newClient.okLinked: Record created and linked to the existing account

moveClient.title: Move {name}
moveClient.note: Both the record (with measurements and notes) and the app account link are moved; the link keeps its current state{status}. If the new professional already has a record for this client, the move is blocked.

links.noAccountHint: The link is not associated with any account
links.crmAbsentActiveHint: No record found for this professional: the client does not appear in their dashboard
links.crmAbsentHint: The record is created or attached automatically when the link becomes active
links.activateHint: Activate (accept the invitation on behalf of the professional)
links.moveNoteMoved: The link keeps its current state; the CRM record moves with it.
links.moveNoteCreated: The link keeps its current state; the CRM record is created under the new professional.
links.moveOk: Client and record moved to the new professional
links.deleteDescription: The client will lose this link to the professional. This cannot be undone.

monitoring.count: {count, plural, one {# monitoring session} other {# monitoring sessions}}

users.migration024: Account state, expiry dates and modules not available: apply migration 024.
users.extendMonths: +{months, plural, =12 {1 year} one {# month} other {# months}}
users.extendReason: Quick extension +{months, plural, =12 {1 year} one {# month} other {# months}}
users.suspendDescription: {name}: sign-in allowed with the "Account suspended" screen.
users.moduleRemoveException: Removes the exception: the plan applies again.

overview.migration024: The commercial overview needs migration 024 (account state, subscriptions, modules).
overview.expiringSubtitle: within 30 days or expired and waiting for the nightly job · reminders at 30, 7 and 1 day

commerciale.fonteScaduto: Included in the plan, but subscription expired
commerciale.fonteProfessionistaOff: No linked professional with the module

sidePanel.migration024: State, subscription and modules not available: apply migration 024.
sidePanel.statusHelp: Suspended: sign-in allowed, "Account suspended" screen, no clients or measurements. Blocked: sign-in denied and session closed. Reactivation restores everything (no data is touched).
sidePanel.expiryHelp: Empty = no expiry. Last valid day included.
sidePanel.autoRenewHelp: at expiry it renews for the same duration instead of suspending
sidePanel.followPlanHint: Remove the exception: the plan applies again
sidePanel.modulesHelp: Solid icon = included in the plan. Dashed border = exception for this account. Clients: covered by the linked professional, unless an exception applies.
sidePanel.dangerHelp: Deletion removes the auth account and the profile. To stop an account without losing data use Suspend or Block.
sidePanel.statusExpiredWarning: Warning: the subscription has expired, tonight's job will suspend it again unless you extend it.
sidePanel.sameAsPlan: Same as the plan: saved as an explicit exception (useful with an expiry date).
sidePanel.changeRoleToClient: The user will become a client. Make sure they do not lose access to their data.
sidePanel.changeRoleToProfessional: The user will become a professional. Make sure they do not lose access to their data.
sidePanel.deleteDescription: You are about to delete {name}. In-studio measurements of clients with an account are handed over to them; cards without an account, measurements and files are deleted. This cannot be undone.
sidePanel.setPasswordHelp: The password takes effect immediately. Share it with the user over a secure channel.

merge.title: Merge duplicate records
merge.description: Moves measurements, notes, alerts and every other reference to the record to keep, then deletes the duplicates. All in one transaction.
merge.search: Filter by name, email or professional…
merge.previewEmpty: No references to move: only the duplicate records will be deleted.
merge.conflictWarning: {count} rows will NOT be moved but deleted, because the record to keep already has an equivalent one (uniqueness constraints). On execution their full content is saved in the audit log (action «merge_conflict_delete»): recoverable afterwards.
merge.atomicWarning: The {count} merged records will be deleted at the end. The operation is atomic: it either fully succeeds or changes nothing.
merge.confirmDescription: {moved} rows will be moved to "{name}"{conflict} and {count} records will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge.confirmConflict: , {count} deleted for conflict (snapshot in the audit log)
merge.done: Merge completed: {moved} rows moved{conflict}, {count} records deleted

manualLink.title: Link client to professional
manualLink.description: Enter the email the client used to create their account. The CRM record is created or attached automatically.
manualLink.noCrm: No CRM record found after the operation: check the tg_create_client_on_active_link trigger.
manualLink.roleNote: Note: this user has the professional role, not client.
manualLink.help: The link is created on the client's account and becomes active right away: the professional's CRM record is attached (by email) or created automatically. If a revoked or pending link already exists for the same pair, it is activated.

emailChange.title: Fix the account email
emailChange.description: Current: {email}. Sign-in, password reset and invitations will use the new email.
emailChange.errSame: It is already the account email
emailChange.conflictTitle: Email already used by another account
emailChange.conflictDetails: {name} · role {role} · created {created} · last sign-in {lastSignIn} · {sessions} measurements from the app · {cardSessions} on their records · {links} active links
emailChange.conflictHelp: Two accounts for the same person: the fix is not possible. Keep the account holding the data, revoke the other one's link and merge the records from the Clients tab.
emailChange.uidNote: The uid does not change: measurements, monitoring, baselines and links stay with the account. profiles.email is updated too.
emailChange.cardsToUpdate: Records aligned to the new email
emailChange.cardsNotTouched: {count} records with the old email under professionals without a link stay unchanged: {ids}
emailChange.partial: Account email fixed, but alignment incomplete: see admin_audit_log

types.ponte_mancante: Missing bridge (record without account, profile with the same email)
types.pending_vecchio: Requests pending for more than 30 days
types.link_duplicato: Duplicate links for the same pair
types.scheda_con_ponte_senza_link: Record with account but without link
types.analytics_disallineato: Analytics attributed to a record other than the session's

salute.bridgeDescription: {who}: the record will be attached to the profile with the same email (one record per professional, duplicates merged).
salute.linkDescription: {who} ↔ {professional}: record attached or created, link active, duplicate links revoked.
salute.revokeDescription: {who}: the client's profile no longer exists, link {link} will be set to revoked.
salute.realignDescription: measurement_analytics.client_id will be set back to the session's record, for all misaligned rows.
salute.viewUnavailableHelp: Apply migrations 019 and 020 on Supabase (v_collegamenti_salute) to enable this tab.
salute.title: Link health
salute.doNotMergeHint: Different people with the same email: the group does not reappear until a new record is added
salute.linkCandidateTitle: Link the client to this professional?
salute.linkCandidateDescription: {who} ↔ {professional}: their remote measurements will become visible to this practice. Make sure this really is their professional.
salute.excludeHelp: The records stay separate and the group disappears from this tab and from the 022 preview. It reappears only if the professional creates another record with the same email.
salute.excludeReasonPlaceholder: E.g. registers family members with their own email
salute.excludeDone: Group marked as not to be merged

healthCheck.migrationBody: The report uses the admin_data_health RPC defined in supabase-migrations/017_client_user_id_admin_ops.sql. Apply it on Supabase and reload.
healthCheck.reasonNoCrm: Broken bridge: the active link attaches no CRM record
healthCheck.reasonNoMeasurements: Record attached but zero visible measurements
healthCheck.linkedNoDataSub: Active link but the professional sees nothing: possible attachment problem.
healthCheck.orphanSub: Non-professional users with self sessions but no active link: nobody sees that data.
healthCheck.duplicatesSub: Same email under the same professional: merge them with the panel tool.
healthCheck.noEmailSub: Without email and without client_user_id, remote measurements can never be attached.
healthCheck.appVersionsSub: Users per version and last detected sign-in.
healthCheck.appVersionsUnavailable: Data not available: the app_version / last_seen_at columns on profiles come from ongoing work on the Flutter app.
healthCheck.stalePendingSub: Links pending for more than 7 days: the professional probably has not seen them.

planToggle.confirmBase: Move {name} back to the Basic plan? They will lose access to the Sport module.
planToggle.networkError: Network error: could not update the plan.
